Exact record line: "2026-02-26 | ROYAL TOUCH OVERSEAS PRIVATE LIMITED TO | COTTON LINEN (MIXED) MADEUPS (SCARVES)(DETAILS AS PER INVOICE) WE INT. CLM.BNF. UND. ROSCTL SCHEME- | KOLKATA ACC INCCU4, India | MOSCOW, RUSSIA | 62149099 | BOL 1035335". Further dated export rows seen: 2026-02-24 to MILAN, ITALY, HS 62141020, BOL 9947804; 2026-02-19 to MILAN, ITALY, HS 62069000, BOL 9803336; 2026-02-05 to MILAN, ITALY (buyer TESSILNOVITA S.R.L), HS 62142029, BOL 9416929. Source counter vs rows actually seen: page claims 696 total shipments; I saw 5 individual dated rows (4 export, 1 import) plus aggregated partner/port tables (MILAN 96, KOLKATA ACC INCCU4 94, KOLKATA ACC 8, MILAN MALPENSA 2, BARCELONA 2). Declared HS 621490 matches the observed export HS 62149099 (cotton/linen scarves) — no HS correction needed.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS code and B/L numbers — not merely a website claim. Company address on record: PARIDHAN GARMENT PARK SDF 2 ROOM 403, 3RD FLOOR, 19, CANAL SOUTH ROAD (Kolkata), consistent with the KOLKATA ACC INCCU4 port lane; it is a manufacturer-exporter of textile madeups (scarves, woven ladies garments) that also imports raw fabric (e.g. 2026-01-31 import from LINIFICIO E CANAPIFICIO NAZIONALE SRL, Italy, HS 53061090, BOL 7227882), i.e. likely manufacturer_trader. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (connection refused) and registry pages (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403, tofler returned 404. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free view: null, not estimated. Note the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) does not match the observed business (textile madeups/scarves); HS 621490 is correct for the actual goods, so the company is retained with the HS as declared and the industry label should be corrected to textiles/apparel.
